predecessors.name: Stem Duchy of Saxony
predecessors.text: the city of Magdeburg, the bulk of the Magdeburg Börde, the Jerichow Land and the exclaves Halle, Oebisfelde and Jüterbog

ledger.x: 1180: the archbishops become princes of the Empire.
1503: Halle becomes a capital alongside Magdeburg (infobox); Moritzburg at Halle was built 1484-1503 as the archbishops' residence (Halle page).
1635: the see passes to a Saxon prince.

wars.name: Quarrel with Brandenburg under Albrecht II
wars.outcome: 'Under Albrecht II (1205-32), a quarrel with Margrave Otto II of Brandenburg greatly damaged the archbishopric.'

wars.name: Brandenburg domination of the see
wars.outcome: Günther I (1277-79) 'hardly escaped a serious war' with Margrave Otto IV; the Brandenburgers then forced Günther I and Bernhard III to resign and installed Eric of Brandenburg (1282/83-1295).

wars.name: Sack of Magdeburg (1631)
wars.outcome: 'Christian William was taken prisoner after the sack of Magdeburg' in 1631; the Peace of Prague of 1635 gave the archbishopric to August of Saxe-Weissenfels.

certainty.note: The page names no border; every region is a circle around a named place.
